kraken.source_field_note: Kraken ticker field o is the UTC-day open; do not label it rolling 24-hour open.

cross_venue.interpretation: Not an arbitrage signal: USD/USDT basis, asynchronous event times, fees, transfer constraints and slippage are not normalized.

orderbook_depth.okx_level1_displayed_sizes: Ask-heavy at the captured level only; not a depth curve or executable support.

xrp_insights.stated_universe: Six US spot funds plus BITW for combined holdings.
exclusions_and_caveats: GXRP flow is excluded due the 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-28 issuer-page capture gap; GXRP holdings and AUM remain in totals.
BITW is a multi-asset index fund; XRP sleeve changes can reflect index rebalancing.
XRP-paid fees can change holdings and are counted as flow.
Several historical daily rows are reconstructed from third-party estimates between issuer-reported anchors; daily allocation is estimated.
Issuer files can settle overnight/next morning; provisional rows can be rewritten.
USD flow can use NAV-implied prices where spot snapshots are missing.

alpha_finance.upstream_dashboard_feed: CoinGlass, per Alpha Finance methodology page.
alpha_finance.methodology: Alpha states figures are displayed as published, not smoothed or adjusted; its ETF Dashboard feed is CoinGlass.

why_not_comparable: XRP Insights computes a day-over-day change in issuer-reported XRP holdings; Alpha's dashboard reads the CoinGlass ETF flow feed.
XRP Insights includes six spot products plus BITW in its holdings universe but excludes GXRP from computed flow; Alpha displays five funds including GXRP while omitting XRPR and BITW.
XRP Insights reports XRP units and USD valuation; Alpha reports USD flow and no fund-level holdings in the captured XRP panel.
Different fund coverage and publication vintages prevent the values from being averaged or interpreted as one market-wide creation/redemption total.
etf_flow_reconciliation.source_independence: Distinct publishers and upstream pipelines are observed, but both may ultimately rely on overlapping issuer holdings/flow data. They are not independent confirmations of net primary-market capital.

competing_etf_explanations: XRP-paid fund fees and BITW index rebalancing altering holdings without equivalent investor cash flow.
Different fund universes, issuer publication lags, capture gaps, provisional settlements and CoinGlass versus issuer-scraped feeds.
XRPR mixed direct/indirect exposure may be counted differently by aggregators.
source_disagreements_and_counter_hypothe.disconfirming_evidence: The data do not provide a common fund universe with issuer-level primary-market creation/redemption records. Alpha's zero is not proof of no activity; XRP Insights' negative holdings delta is not proof of equivalent net cash outflow.

reasons: Kraken provider event time is absent.
OKX observation is stale by 82.033 seconds at the reference time.
Binance observation is at the 300-second freshness boundary and the exact retrieval time is not exposed.
USD/USDT basis and execution costs are not normalized.
Only Level-1 order-book data are present; no full depth.
ETF metrics are non-comparable publisher-derived measures with different fund universes and methodologies.
No synchronized raw issuer creations/redemptions files were captured.
